definitions.explanation: Pleasant or significant memories from the past, often with emotional attachment.

notes:
{思|おも}い{出|で} refers to memories, often with emotional or nostalgic connotations.

FORMS:
{思|おも}い (thought) + {出|で} (coming out) - memories that 'come out' when recalled

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {思|おも}い{出|で}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a memory
- {思|おも}い{出|で}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to remain in one's memory
- {思|おも}い{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make memories
- {思|おも}い{出|で}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よみがえる→蘇る：04004_yomigaeru⟧: memories come flooding back
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{思|おも}い{出|で}: good/fond memories

RELATED VERB:
⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: to remember, recall ({出|で} reading varies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧: memory (more neutral/scientific)
- ⟦{追憶|ついおく}→追憶：15687_tsuioku⟧: reminiscence (literary)
